panels.description: A thief cuts the tanker hose; the free end whips across the deck. Leave upper deck space for the impact sound.
The barge pulls away while TJ's torso and remaining legs converge beneath the damaged drone. The thieves abandon the disabled equipment; leave upper sky open for dialogue.
TJ's fourth leg catches on the drone frame above the dark lake. Keep the magnetic joint and bent frame dominant.
From shore, the granddaughter watches as the leg tears loose from TJ. Older Alex remains behind her near the boathouse. Leave upper water space for her cry.
